quotations.old_english: Hé suá micle bet his ágen dysig oncnéw suá hé undruncenra wæs
quotations.english: he recognized his own folly so much better as he was more sober

source_text: un-druncen; adj. Not drunk, sober :-- Hé suá micle bet his ágen dysig oncnéw suá hé undruncenra wæs he recognized his own folly so much better as he was more sober, Past. 40; Swt. 295, 8. [Icel. ú-drukkinn.]
